Zero linter errors. Here's what changed across all four components:

---

**MetricCards** — 6 generic number tiles → 5 purposeful KPI cards
- Each card has a color-coded icon badge (blue/violet/emerald/sky/rose) and a **progress ring** showing the metric as a % of cases (e.g. "72% of cases have assessments")
- Reduced from 6 cards to 5 by collapsing Resets + Transfers into a single **Flags & Alerts** card that pulses rose when anything is non-zero
- Sub-labels give context: "48.2% pipeline completion" instead of just a raw count

**ActivityChart** — Vertical stacked bar → **horizontal stacked bar**
- Long centre names now read clearly along the Y axis
- Softer, alpha-blended colors (blue/violet/emerald)
- Modern dark tooltip (near-black with subtle border), circular legend dots, no harsh grid lines
- Axes use Inter font to match the rest of the UI

**EventTypeChart** — Doughnut chart → **Care Pathway Throughput panel**
- Shows Cases → Assessments → Results as horizontal bars anchored to the same max (cases), so the drop-off is immediately visible
- Each bar shows its conversion % below it: "71.5% of cases have an assessment"
- Resets and Transfers surface as operational flag pills at the bottom, only shown when non-zero

**CentreTable** — Plain sortable table → **insight-rich breakdown**
- Row numbers added for quick ranking reference
- Cases / Assessments / Results columns now show an **inline mini-bar** so you can read the relative volume at a glance without doing mental math
- Completion % column now has a **color-coded micro-progress bar** (emerald ≥75%, amber ≥40%, rose <40%)
- New **Status pill** column: Healthy / In Progress / Low / Idle — instantly tells you which centres need attention
